title: HoliAntiSpoof: Audio LLM for Holistic Speech Anti-Spoofing
reasoning: The paper describes the development and benchmarking of a speech anti-spoofing framework using Audio Large Language Models. While the introduction mentions ethical risks of generative models and the Impact Statement discusses personal privacy and security, the core of the work is technical spoofing detection and does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
